vulnerabilities.title: Improper Authentication
vulnerabilities.description: Versions of the package jsonwebtoken before 9.0.0 are vulnerable to Improper Authentication due to a special characters in the secretOrPublicKey option being allowed.

vulnerabilities.title: Weak Secret Validation
vulnerabilities.description: Algorithms are not properly validated. A library user could specify an algorithm that is not secure.

ignoredIssues.title: Prototype Pollution
ignoredIssues.ignoreReason: xlsx@0.18.5 is used for internal bulk product import only. The prototype pollution CVE requires attacker-controlled input to the xlsx parser. Import is restricted to authenticated admin users. Risk accepted pending vendor patch.
ignoredIssues.note: Package is not available via npm registry. Snyk scan covers npm-installed packages only. xlsx is loaded via bundled path in /src/server/src/modules/product/. CVE visibility depends on manual policy entry — not detected via registry scan.

ignoredIssues.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
ignoredIssues.ignoreReason: ReDoS in xlsx regex patterns. Exploitable via malformed spreadsheet input. Import restricted to admin-controlled files. Risk accepted pending evaluation of xlsxjs/exceljs migration.

ignoredIssues.title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
ignoredIssues.ignoreReason: Same scope and acceptance criteria as SNYK-JS-XLSX-8219869.

dependenciesScanned.note: Off-registry packages (loaded outside npm install) are not included in this count. xlsx@0.18.5 is distributed via author CDN and is not visible to Snyk registry-based scanning. CVEs for this package were added to the .snyk ignore policy manually after out-of-band discovery.
